notes.title: Creators, Happy New Year 2023!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9848493/2e2d73b6b4adcebdf5e3925059aea2e7511f35c7.png[/img]
❤️ Dear Creators!

2022 Year coming to an end and we are ready to step into what awaits us in 2023! With your constant support and love we have managed to achieve a lot of things! 
We hope that the outgoing year has been a success and brought you a lot of nice moments both with our Doodle Games, and in the Doodle Community.
For us this year was a year of preparation, constant development and Community building. And you were part of all these processes throughout the year!

It was not a secret, that our main priority was Doodle God Universe, and everything that surrounds it. We have gone a long way from the first PC version launch, till the large-scale public playtest and worldwide demo version release! Thanks to you, the game is developing in the right direction and is already quite different from what it was originally. This year we have collected so much feedback that it would be enough to develop a completely new game! Your ideas from challenges and activities, your view from the outside added motivation for us to develop and make the game better! Our Community on Discord and other platforms has grown rapidly throughout the year - from 0 we are now almost 11000 users on Discord! And that is just less than in a year. 

And now, what awaits us in 2023? Of course it is Doodle God Universe release https://bit.ly/3woNfWu - improved, with new features, new elements and new 3D scenes! In 2023, the World and the Community of Doodle God is set to get even bigger. More updates, more content: Episode 3 is coming! 
Of course we will not forget about our previous Doodle Games. In the coming year we will be releasing other Doodle Games to the Epic Store, Varenje will get a Playstation and Nintendo release, Worlds Builder will finally hit Steam! 

There is so much more we want to tell you about the future of our Universe, but today is the day of celebration! Needless to say, that we just wouldn't be the same without you, we are all together THE Doodle God Universe!  

From all of us at JoyBits - to all of you, Creators: We wish you a Happy New Year 2023! 
Next year is going to be lit 🔥

With love,
JoyBits Team

notes.title: Global update for all Doodle God games
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9848493/4ab41be74be8b502bc48c5696d972fa86b94221e.png[/img]

Dear Steam users, 
We are excited to release a major update to all Doodle God games. We attempted to take into account as much of your feedback as possible to deliver a better Doodle God experience. 
Thank you for taking the time to help us make the game better!

[h1]Changes:[/h1] [list][*]“Frames” are back in the game
Some time ago we made the decision to remove Frames from the shop. 
After receiving your feedback we have improved the frames system and now you can once again use frames to help you complete the game. In the new version, frames will open automatically once you have completed a certain number of reactions and remain available to you for the rest of the game. Frame that hide repeated reactions will unlock first. 

[*]Improved the main menu screen
We have re-designed the menu screen for the computer screens.  

[*]Removed the "Wheel of Fortune” &  “Daily Rewards”

[*]Removed the "Energy” system
Players will no longer need to accumulate any currency.
We believe this will make for a longer and more enjoyable game experience. 

[*]Improved the "Show Possible Reaction" hint system.
Players can now benefit from this hint system at any point in the game. This hint now works as a "Mission" button prompting players to think about a particular new element they can choose to create at that moment. 

[*]Improved the "Show Two Groups” hint (two light bulbs icon)
We wanted to allow the player to have longer play sessions and to provide more hints if the player is in need of help. 

[*]Removed the  “Show Reaction” hint (energy-saving light bulb icon) 

[*]Decreased the “Please rate our game” prompts
Players will not longer be interrupted by this prompt. This will only occur as players exit the game. 

[*]We improved the overall balance of the game. 

[*]Improved the games compatibility with different pc and laptop configurations[/list] 

Once again thank you for providing feedback and for helping us make Doodle God a better game. 
We hope you enjoy the update. 
JoyBits Ltd.

notes.title: We Hear You -- ALL Micro-transactions Are Removed!!
notes.notes:
[u][b]NO MICROTRANSACTIONS![/b][/u]

We hope you enjoy this version. If you like this new version please let us know.

Thanks!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Doodle God, 20% off!
notes.notes:
Doodle God is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Doodle God is an addicting puzzle & world building game where players use logic and ingenuity to create the entire universe. Starting with the basic elements of earth, wind, fire and air players can build a world filled with locomotives, Dragons, skyscrapers, Aliens and more.

*Offer ends October 1 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: New Mission Mode Will Keep You Playing
notes.notes:
In addition to the new "Planet" mode, Doodle God for Steam will also include the new "Mission" mode.  As you populate your world with new elements players will be challenged by new Missions that pop up while you are playing. If you successfully solve the Mission players will be rewarded with tokens.

notes.title: New Planet Mode - See Your World Come Alive
notes.notes:
We are excited to bring to Steam two new games modes. The first is "Planet" mode which allows players to see their world come alive as they successfully make new elements. For instance, if you create a Volcano, the game screen will fly to a new Planet screen where you will see the Volcano appear on your planet. Players can rotate and zoom in and out of their planet to see the hight quality animations come alive as they play.

[img]http://doodlegod.com/banners/steam/All_planet_01_640.jpg[/img]
